copy.storyHeading: Built for people buying their first house
story: Nusa Rekabina started in 2020 in Puncak Alam, where most of our neighbours were collecting keys to their first house with almost nothing left after the down payment.

Six years and 180 homes later our prices are still published openly, because the people we work for cannot afford a surprise. If you only need the kitchen and the grille this year, we will quote you the kitchen and the grille.

process.title: Tell Us Your Budget
process.text: We start from what you can actually spend, not from what we would like to sell you. Our package prices are published, so you can work out roughly where you stand before we even meet.

process.title: Prioritise the Essentials
process.text: Grille, kitchen and wiring first — the things you cannot move in without. Feature walls and nice-to-haves can wait for next year, and we will tell you which is which.

process.title: Finish in 30 Days
process.text: Most terrace packages complete within a month so you are not paying rent and instalments at the same time. Payment is staged, with instalment plans available on request.
